limitations: GitHub can change between requests; the explicit observation window and immutable document revisions define this record.
Repository issue totals exclude pull requests. Closed pull requests are not assumed merged. Number gaps are not missing objects when the paginated collection is complete.
Project hierarchy rows are filtered and loaded separately from descendants. No Project membership or historical activity total is inferred from a rendered view or its initial page.
Project node IDs are opaque values read from GitHub. Field database IDs and UI IDs are separately named; they are not synthesized GraphQL node IDs or an executable field-option mapping.
All configured field definitions are recorded, including built-in fields. Project-specific vocabularies and existing assignees/parents are preserved.
Public visibility does not itself establish a collector installation, source-event coverage, individual consent, evidence acceptance or public release.
Research and market decision records remain in the research repository; its frozen builder contracts are separate from leaderboard contracts.
The 2026-10-17 planning/source-audit.json remains an unchanged historical snapshot.
